summary: SPP and its transmission owner Joint Movants, now including Xcel Energy Services, file an amended motion for a 95-day abeyance of the EL26-68 show cause proceeding, to November 20, 2026, and describe SPP's planned section 205 revisions.
ask: Hold the proceeding, including the briefing questions deadline, in abeyance for 95 days through November 20, 2026, with a five-day answer period and prompt action.

points.point: Joint Movants, with Xcel Energy Services added, ask for 95 days, five more than the order contemplates, to fit SPP's Board meeting.
points.quote: The additional five (5) days is necessary to accommodate SPP's full stakeholder process, which culminates in a scheduled Board of Directors

points.point: SPP will add alternative transmission technology evaluation to its HILL study process, which does not now require it.
points.quote: it does not currently require SPP to evaluate alternative transmission technologies when studying HILLs.

points.point: SPP will revise pro forma NITS and point-to-point service agreements to carry HILL operational requirements.
points.quote: to develop revisions to the Tariff's pro forma transmission service agreements

points.point: The CARE Team is weighing financial security, direct assignment of upgrade costs and minimum contributions from customers serving large loads.
points.quote: direct assignment, in whole or in part, of Network Upgrade costs associated with large load delivery point additions or modifications

points.point: On co-location and behind-the-meter generation, stakeholders must settle terminology, the study process and overlap among transmission, interconnection and market registration.
points.quote: the overlap between transmission service, interconnection, and market registration requirements.

points.point: Price Adaptive Load Service would create non-firm service with usage-based pricing and mandatory dispatchability.
points.quote: PALS would establish a new transmission service under which participating loads would receive transmission service subject to usage-based pricing, mandatory dispatchability requirements

points.point: Working group votes run September and October, MOPC in October, RSC in November, and the Board on November 17, 2026.
points.quote: culminating in working group votes during September and October, MOPC in October, the RSC where applicable in November, and final Board consideration on November 17, 2026.

throughLine.text: Invokes the E-9 abeyance option and previews SPP's section 205 package on the order's alternative-technology, cost-recovery, co-location and flexible-load directives.

figures.label: Abeyance requested by SPP Joint Movants
figures.quote: abeyance for ninety-five (95) days, up to and including November 20, 2026

figures.label: SPP HILL threshold above 69 kV
figures.quote: (2) 50 MW or more if connected to the Transmission System at a voltage level greater than 69 kV
